dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: 49ers (9-1) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Seahawks
bullets: Roster & Front Office: San Francisco signed WR Brandin Cooks to the practice squad [Taylor Wirth](https://www.nbcsportsbayarea.com/nfl/san-francisco-49ers/source-john-lynch-contract-extension/1982608/).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Kyle Shanahan and the medical staff evaluate QB Brock Purdy (ankle), OT Trent Williams (lower leg), DE Khalid Kareem (ankle), and CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Jason Aponte](https://www.ninersnation.com/san-francisco-49ers-injuries/166304/49ers-injury-report-brock-purdy-suffered-an-ankle-injury).

Week 12 Seahawks Outlook: Kyle Shanahan and DC Raheem Morris open installation for the Seattle Seahawks (6-4, SF -2.5, HC Mike Macdonald, OC Brian Fleury & DC Aden Durde (Levi's Stadium)) at high altitude in Mexico City—a unit ranked #1 in Yards Allowed / Game (236.1 yds) as San Francisco prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Jason Aponte](https://www.ninersnation.com/san-francisco-49ers-analysis/166285/why-the-first-matchup-between-the-49ers-and-seahawks-was-so-strange) [Jennifer Lee Chan](https://www.nbcsportsbayarea.com/nfl/san-francisco-49ers/brock-purdy-pff-grades-win-minnesota-vikings/1982783/).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 9-1 (1st in NFC West • #1 Seed in NFC), San Francisco carries a 99.5% postseason projection, 92.7% NFC West division title mark, and 65.7% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Jason Aponte](https://www.ninersnation.com/san-francisco-49ers-injuries/166304/49ers-injury-report-brock-purdy-suffered-an-ankle-injury).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, San Francisco ranks #1 in Points / Game (31.6), #8 in Points Allowed / Game (20.6), #9 in Turnover Differential (+5), giving Kyle Shanahan and Raheem Morris a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 1:25 PM PST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Seattle Seahawks [PFF](https://x.com/PFF/status/2125652044409454974).
